acceptance_criteria.description: Users must be unable to access any page without first logging in with valid credentials. Unauthenticated access should be blocked.
kane_steps: Navigate directly to https://www.saucedemo.com/inventory.html without logging in
Observe that the user is redirected back to the login page
Confirm no inventory content is visible without authentication
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Unauthenticated users cannot access protected pages

acceptance_criteria.description: After submitting valid credentials (standard_user / secret_sauce), the user is redirected to the product inventory page.
kane_steps: Navigate to https://www.saucedemo.com/
Enter username 'standard_user' and password 'secret_sauce'
Click the Login button
Verify the user is redirected to the inventory page (URL contains /inventory.html)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Successful login redirects to inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: The inventory page displays product tiles, each containing a product name, image, and price.
kane_steps: Log in with valid credentials and navigate to the inventory page
Inspect each product tile and confirm a product name is present
Confirm each product tile displays an image and a price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Inventory tiles show name, image, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product name on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the name of any product
Verify the product detail page opens and displays the correct product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product name opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: Clicking a product image on the inventory page opens the product detail page for that product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the image of any product
Verify the product detail page opens and displays the correct product
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Clicking product image opens detail page

acceptance_criteria.description: The product detail page displays the product name, description, price, and an Add to cart button.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click on any product to open its detail page
Verify the product name, description, and price are all visible
Verify an 'Add to cart' button is present on the page
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Product detail shows name, description, price, add button

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can add a product to the cart from the inventory page by clicking the Add to cart button on a product tile.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the 'Add to cart' button on any product tile
Verify the product is added to the cart (cart badge count increases)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: User can add product to cart from inventory

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking Add to cart on a product tile, the button label changes from 'Add to cart' to 'Remove'.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note that the button label reads 'Add to cart' for a product
Click the 'Add to cart' button
Verify the button label has changed to 'Remove'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Add to cart button changes to Remove

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart badge in the top navigation updates to reflect the current number of items in the cart after adding a product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Note the cart badge count (initially absent or zero)
Click 'Add to cart' on one product
Verify the cart badge displays '1'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart badge count updates when item added

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can remove a previously added product from the inventory page by clicking the Remove button on its tile.
kane_steps: Log in, navigate to the inventory page, and add a product to the cart
Click the 'Remove' button on the same product tile
Verify the product is removed from the cart (cart badge count decreases)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: User can remove product from inventory page

acceptance_criteria.description: After clicking Remove on a product tile, the button label changes back from 'Remove' to 'Add to cart'.
kane_steps: Log in, add a product to the cart from the inventory page
Confirm the button label reads 'Remove'
Click the 'Remove' button
Verify the button label reverts to 'Add to cart'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Remove button reverts to Add to cart

acceptance_criteria.description: Users can navigate to the cart page at /cart.html.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Click the cart icon in the top navigation
Verify the URL changes to include /cart.html
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: User can navigate to cart page

acceptance_criteria.description: The cart page lists all items that have been added, showing each item's name, quantity, and price.
kane_steps: Log in, add one or more products to the cart from the inventory page
Navigate to /cart.html
Verify each added product is listed with its name, quantity, and price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Cart page shows item name, quantity, and price

acceptance_criteria.description: A sort dropdown is visible in the top right of the inventory page and users can interact with it.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Locate the sort dropdown in the top right area
Click the dropdown and verify all four sort options are listed: Name (A to Z), Name (Z to A), Price (low to high), Price (high to low)
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Sort dropdown visible with all four options

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (low to high)' from the sort dropdown displays the cheapest product (Sauce Labs Onesie at $7.99) first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Price (low to high)'
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Onesie'
Verify its price shows $7.99
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price low to high sorts Onesie first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Price (high to low)' from the sort dropdown reorders products so the most expensive item appears first.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Price (high to low)'
Verify the first product displayed has the highest price among all products
Verify the last product displayed has the lowest price
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Price high to low shows most expensive first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (A to Z)' from the sort dropdown displays 'Sauce Labs Backpack' as the first product.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Name (A to Z)'
Verify the first product displayed is 'Sauce Labs Backpack'
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name A to Z shows Backpack first

acceptance_criteria.description: Selecting 'Name (Z to A)' from the sort dropdown reorders products in reverse alphabetical order.
kane_steps: Log in and navigate to the inventory page
Open the sort dropdown and select 'Name (Z to A)'
Verify the first product displayed is alphabetically last among all products
Verify the last product displayed is alphabetically first
acceptance_criteria.kane_one_liner: Name Z to A reverses alphabetical product order
